_note: Overland zones (design/07, approved by Brent 2026-10-18). Coordinates are metres in the zone's own map frame: origin at the north-west corner, x east, y south; north is the far side of the screen. A zone is built by scripts/zone_builder.gd. lines: gaps in the edge that lead somewhere - 'to' is a zone id, 'town', or a dungeon; a line that is not 'open' is drawn shut with a sign. arrive: where you stand when you come in by that line. All numbers [MODEL].

the_stubble.name: The Stubble
the_stubble.desc: The yard outside the Dross Gate: open scrub, the city tip, a dry well, a hanging tree, and at the far side the Cut House over the mouth of Tenwall Cut.

lines.name: The Drove Stile
lines.sign: The Drove Stile. The road runs on to Longacre Drove - nobody has gone that way yet.

lines.name: The Wet Gap
lines.sign: The Wet Gap. Beyond the fence the ground turns to Sumpside - closed for now.
